info.description: One paid month of a plan for an account (pricing.md). Created when a plan order is marked paid; the account's plan = the highest active period covering now. Set status to cancelled to revoke.

providerReference.description: Payment order reference, e.g. PLN-7KQ3XZ (empty when granted by staff).

orderKey.description: order:<documentId> — guarantees one period per paid order.
